summary: Lumen Technologies and its subsidiary Qwest Corporation settled exchange offers and consent solicitations for certain outstanding notes, issuing $1,002,320,075 of 6.500% Notes due 2051 and $381,528,000 of 6.750% Notes due 2052. This is a routine debt exchange to extend maturities or modify terms; no equity securities, special distributions, or strategic changes are involved. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal-specific premium is mentioned. The filing does not trigger a special situation classification.
